via.name: Frew Creek

evidence: A side road to the left some 100 m past the second bridge leads to the Whitcombe road end.
Once at the road end drop down to the riverbed and walk upstream along the river’s edge for 15-20 minutes to where rock cairns and orange markers show the way to the cut track.
From Neave Creek Hut the track leads through alpine scrub to the Whitcombe River near the Gateway. From here travel to the Pass is via the riverbed, crossing the river where convenient.

side_trips.name: Wilkinson Hut

doubts: The page describes the way only as far as Whitcombe Pass (DOC time '3-4 days to Whitcombe Pass') and does not say whether walkers return the same way or cross the pass, so the shape is left null. The start is the Whitcombe road end car park; the packet has no road end feature, so its ref is null. Neave Creek Hut has no name entry (T9 is the creek), so its ref is null. The historic slab hut on Price Flat is also habitable but the text gives Price Flat Hut as the hut.
